security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, and example CLI snippets. I confirmed one low-risk remote Markdown image and added a low-risk context finding because prompts and reference images are processed by a third-party inference service.

remediation.suggestion: State clearly that prompts, parameters, and reference image URLs are sent to inference.sh and Alibaba Qwen-Image apps.

remediation.issue: The README embeds a remote preview image.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the preview image locally or replace it with a plain link to avoid automatic third-party asset requests.

remediation.issue: Related skill installation commands expand the user trust boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Mark install commands as optional manual steps and link to verified installation documentation when possible.

content.value_statement: Image teams need fast Qwen-Image prompts without writing API calls. This skill turns natural language requests into inference.sh image generation and editing runs.
actual_capabilities: Runs Qwen-Image-2.0 and Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the inference.sh CLI.
Creates images from natural language prompts with optional image count settings.
Supports custom output width and height within the documented pixel limits.
Edits images with one to three reference image URLs.
Uses negative prompts, seeds, and prompt extension settings for control.
Provides model guidance for text-heavy posters and precise text rendering.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
Sends prompts, parameters, and reference image URLs to a remote service.
Reference image editing is limited to one to three input images.
Output quality depends on model behavior and prompt clarity.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate draft posters, sale graphics, and social images with stronger text rendering from the Pro model.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Produce several visual directions from one prompt, then refine size, style, and seed settings.

use_cases.title: Edit With References
use_cases.description: Combine subject, clothing, or pose references into a new generated image for creative review.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one Qwen image of a calm mountain lake at sunrise. Use the fast model and a square format.

prompt_templates.title: Create Multiple Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate four logo concepts for a modern coffee shop. Use a minimalist style and keep the colors warm.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Text Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Qwen-Image Pro to create a vertical poster with the exact headline Summer Sale and clear supporting text.

prompt_templates.title: Edit From References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use three reference image URLs to combine the person, outfit, and pose into one polished editorial image.

output_examples.input: Create a futuristic city skyline at sunset with flying cars.
output_examples.output: The skill runs the fast Qwen-Image model and returns one generated PNG with the requested city scene.

output_examples.input: Make a vertical sale poster with exact headline text and a beach background.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the Pro model, keeps prompt extension disabled when needed, and returns a text-focused poster image.

output_examples.input: Combine a person reference, clothing reference, and pose reference into one image.
output_examples.output: The skill submits the three references for image editing and returns a new composite PNG for review.

best_practices: Use Qwen-Image Pro for posters, signage, and exact visible text.
Set a seed when you need reproducible visual exploration.
Avoid confidential prompts or private image URLs unless your data policy allows remote processing.
anti_patterns: Do not expect local-only generation because the workflow uses inference.sh.
Do not provide more than three reference images for editing.
Do not rely on vague prompts when composition, text, or size must be precise.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates and edits images with Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0 models through inference.sh.

faq.question: Does it need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the inference.sh CLI installed and authenticated before running model requests.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use the Pro model?
faq.answer: Use Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro for posters, text-heavy images, and stronger prompt adherence.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports editing with one to three reference image URLs.

faq.question: Are prompts processed locally?
faq.answer: No. Prompts and reference image URLs are sent to the remote inference.sh service.
